The first written reference to the word tattoo (or tatau), appears in the journal of Joseph Banks (24 February 1743 – 19 June 1820), the naturalist aboard Captain Cook's ship the HMS Endeavour: "I shall now mention the way they mark themselves indelibly, each of them is so marked by their humor or disposition".

The word "tattoo" was brought to Europe by the explorer James Cook, when he returned in 1771 from his first voyage to Tahiti and New Zealand. In his narrative of the voyage, he refers to an operation called "tattaw". Before this it had been described as scarring, painting, or staining

Created by artist, intuitive healer, and disabilities advocate Emily Anderson, these 100 charming characters encourage self-empowerment and positive thinking with an energy all their own. You can trust that just the right fairy will appear every time. 

Each fairy is a positive entity, carrying a message that aims to reach the space around your heart and hold it gently. From “Fairy of Grandmother Tree” to “Fairy of Not Doing and All Gets Done,” each contains the potential to shift your focus or perspective and lead to new insights.

'Fairy of the Day' originates with the daily drawing practice devised by Anderson to process life’s difficulties while living alone in the Vermont countryside. 

 “As I began sharing the deck with others,” Anderson says, “people were amazed at how easily the fairies brought positivity and relevance to their lives.” 

With ‘Fairy of the Day,’ you can select multiple fairies every day and share the fairies’ wisdom with friends, family, and strangers. We've even heard of some meetings that begin with picking a Fairy of the Day!

'Fairy of the Day' offers a new way to connect in with yourself, each day. People all over the world are using the app to welcome joy into their lives. Join the community.

‘Fairy of the Day’ includes:
•	100 original fairies to discover and get acquainted with
•	An active archive of your most recently selected fairies (up to 30)
•	Inspiration and suggestions for how to use ‘Fairy of the Day’

Looking for somewhere to make your first skydive? Are you an experienced skydiver looking for fun new places to jump? Then this app is for you!

Dropzones lists all current U.S. Parachute Association (USPA) member dropzones in an easy to navigate interface. Because these dropzones are USPA certified, you can be assured that the staff, training, equipment, and airplanes are top-quality!

* Quickly find the dropzones closest to where you are now!

* See a map of every USPA certified dropzone in the universe!
* Detailed information about each dropzone.

Use this app to plan your next skydiving road trip across the United States!
